name: 47904 · Lafayette, IN
findings: ZIP 47904 (Lafayette) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 47904 (Lafayette) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 47904 (Lafayette) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
